name: แมพใหม่
readme: Tiles are 16 px. Coordinates are tiles, x to the right, y down, (0,0) top-left. groundRows[y][x] is a key of groundKey; roadRows uses roadKey ("." = no road). Objects: x,y = top-left tile of the footprint (fw x fh tiles, the solid base); the sprite is drawn centred on the footprint and stands on its bottom edge, sprite width = tw tiles. asset = id in assets; game art has src "game:<sprite name>" (assets/v10/<name>.webp), imported art has a data URL.
